caption: The drawing depicts a historical dress composed of a fitted bodice and a wide skirt. The main garment is a peach-colored, floor-length gown decorated with vertical stripes and scattered floral patterns in pink, purple, and green. The bodice has a square neckline trimmed with lace, and the sleeves are three-quarter length, ending in ruffled, layered lace cuffs. The skirt is open at the front, revealing an underskirt with a diamond-patterned design and a lower section adorned with floral lace embroidery. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, monochrome sketch showing the back view of the dress, which includes the same floral detailing and loose draping. The entire composition is set against a plain beige background.
title: Silk Gown
